measure_definition.first_score_difference: First full-logit hash disagreement through the shared prefix. A hash mismatch does not quantify the effect or identify a cause.
measure_definition.margin: Score of the edited chosen token minus score of the original chosen token at the first differing prediction, when both tokens are present in that run's saved top-eight scores.
measure_definition.outcome: All three final requested fields correct, from evidence.json. Does not assert coherent explanation.

accounting_patterns.definition: Exact arithmetic matches on parsed final fields, not an automatic attribution of the model's procedure. Missing fields remain missing. Multiple expressions may coincide in principle; here descentGainJ is positive.
